real_world_scenario: An Iloilo warehouse district needs a public market hall and learning center. A source-safe adaptive-reuse approach starts by testing whether the existing structure, volume, neighborhood memory, and material stock can serve the new program before defaulting to demolition.
excluded_claims: The rewrite avoids unsupported claims about exact carbon savings, tax credits, Philippine heritage statutes, or project-specific engineering approval. It frames adaptive reuse as a design and preservation strategy that still requires feasibility checks.
